messages:
sam: Heads-up — proposing we expose a normalized header called "X-Embed-Units" so console, routing, and quota math all use the same baseline.

emily: +1. Are we standardizing across dims and bytes? previous splitters make this messy.

ravi: Proposal sketch: units = max(dims / 1024.0, bytes / 4096.0). Round to 0.1 and keep as a float. Compute at the ingress for fast preflight.

olivia: Computing at the edge is fine for preflight UX, but runtime still needs exact routed_units (after splitter). We should emit both: x-embed-units-estimate and x-embed-units-routed.

sam: I like the two-header approach. Clients can backoff on estimate before uploading big chunks. Example: 
```
# client example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \n  -H \"X-Embed-Units: 2.4\" \n  -d @payload.json
```

emily: Console/telemetry work: we should surface an "estimate vs routed" heatmap per-tenant and a tiny preflight failure panel. Also add tooltip copy explaining calculation.

ravi: Telemetry fields I'm adding to the schema: "requested_units", "preflight_estimate", "routed_units", "split_count", "fastfail_reason". Also attach tenant_rollout_stage tag (canary/gradual/ga).

olivia: Rollout plan: opt-in flag per-tenant in console, default off. Canary 5% traffic for 48h, then 25% 24h, then 100% GA. Console shows slider + history.

ingress-bot: Deploy started: embed-units-preflight v1 -> canary(5%) (initiated by ravi)

emily: UX ask: when preflight predicts > 10 units show a soft-warning banner instead of hard-block, with a link to split guidance.

sam: Agreed. Also need a clear fastfail code for client retries: "oversize_unit" so SDKs can surface a better message.

ravi: Making calculations deterministic (no sampling) so dashboards are stable. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingress/pull/987 (adds headers, metrics, and a small unit-test matrix).

olivia: Note for runtime team: please include routed_units at the service boundary so billing and SLOs align.

emily: one more — add a console toggle to show an "example payloads" table demonstrating typical units for common inputs (short prompt, long doc, multi-dim).

sam: Great. Let's do a quick sync tomorrow 11:00 to lock metric names and error codes.
